title: Zero-Touch Maintainer Kiosk for Credentialed Runlets
creator: Priya Patel
description: Build a lightweight, credentialed maintainer kiosk that lets operators execute vetted 'runlets' (small, idempotent runbook tasks) against production and staging clusters with zero-touch UX. The kiosk should present a curated catalog, enforce RBAC and audit logging, support sandbox dry-runs, and automatically record structured outputs to the ops ledger. This ticket covers the minimal viable implementation: a server-side registry for runlets, a web UI shell, an authenticated execution proxy that enforces time-limited credentials, and telemetry hooks for success/failure and argument schema validation.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can see a searchable catalog of runlets with descriptions and required scopes
Execution requires a short-lived, scoped credential issued via the existing KMS flow
Each runlet executes with enforced idempotency markers and produces a JSON result that is persisted to the ops ledger
Dry-run mode executes a simulated path without making state changes and returns a full trace
All executions create an audit event with user, runlet id, args, start/end timestamps, exit status, and a permalink to logs
tasks: Design simple runlet manifest schema (id, version, input_schema, required_scopes, dry_run_flag)
Implement runlet registry service with CRUD API and validation hooks
Build execution proxy that mints time-limited tokens and enforces scopes
Wire audit events to ops ledger and add permalink to Console activity feed
Create minimal web UI: catalog list, argument form generated from input_schema, run button, result pane
Add dry-run mode semantics and sandboxed execution path (no external writes)
Instrument metrics: executions_total, failures_by_runlet, median_runtime, dry_run_ratio
End-to-end tests for RBAC enforcement, idempotency, and result persistence
comments: 2026-02-21 Priya Patel: Kickoff notes added. Decided to scope to read-only + idempotent write primitives for MVP. Assigned to Daniel.

2026-02-27 Daniel Kwan: Spike complete. Prototype registry implemented locally, using JSON Schema for input validation. Found edge-case where nested outputs exceed ledger size — will add compression/attachment flow.
2026-03-03 Marco Jimenez: Security review requested; we'll need short-lived tokens from KMS and a limit on allowed scope bindings. Pushed security checklist to links.
2026-03-10 Priya Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to require structured JSON result persistence and Console permalink. Planning review next week.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Runlets could be weaponized to exfiltrate data. Mitigation: require explicit allowlists for runlets that touch sensitive resources and automatic scanning of runlet manifests.
Risk: Large artifacts exceed ledger storage. Mitigation: store large blobs in attachments bucket and persist references in the ledger.
Risk: Operator errors cause repeated remediation. Mitigation: idempotency tokens and human-confirmation step for runlets with non-reversible effects (out of scope for MVP)
